newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-JUVENTUS SELL VIERI FOR $20 MILLION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JUVENTUS SELL VIERI FOR $20 MILLION.

text.p: Italian champions Juventus said on Wednesday they had sold striker Christian Vieri to Atletico Madrid for $20 million and signed Uruguyan Daniel Fonseca from Roma.
"We've sold Vieri and bought Fonseca," Juventus general manager Luciano Moggi said. He declined to say how much the club had paid for Fonseca.
He said Vieri, who had been linked to Atletico for several weeks, had signed a four-year contract with the Spanish side after a meeting in Rome between officials of the two clubs.
Moggi insisted Juventus had not wanted to sell Vieri, a powerful centre forward who struck up a fluent partnership with Juve striker Alessandro Del Piero last season.
"It was his own decision to go," Moggi said.
Vieri appears to have been worried about losing his first team place in a Juventus squad which includes last season's serie A top scorer Fillipo Inzaghi as well as Del Piero and Fonseca.
